semiconductor_relevance: High — Ion Exchange (India) Ltd. provides critical water management solutions, including ultra-pure water systems essential for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Ion Exchange (India) Ltd. specializes in total water and environment management solutions, offering ultra-pure water systems that meet the stringent quality requirements of the semiconductor industry. Their advanced purification technologies ensure near-zero contaminants, making them a key supplier for semiconductor manufacturing facilities.

regional_presence.India: The company has a strong presence in India with world-class manufacturing facilities and recognized R&D centres.
